hero.prompt: A vast Argentine pampas at deep twilight, an endless flat plain stretching to a far horizon. A long, slender silver Saturn-toned path of pale light recedes across the grassland, narrowing toward a distant warm Cancer amber-gold glow rising on the far edge of the world, as if a sixteen-year arc of patience is finally reaching its light. Deep indigo to near-black sky fading from #16112c to #0b0a1b, soft gold accents in #d4af6a, a teal-and-gold nebula wash drifting high above the plain. Painterly reverent editorial illustration, full-bleed wide 16:9 that fills the frame. ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
hero.altEn: A silver path crosses a vast twilight pampas toward a distant amber-gold horizon glow, evoking Saturn's long arc reaching its light
hero.altZh: 一条银色小径穿过暮色中辽阔的潘帕斯草原，伸向远方琥珀金色的地平线微光，象征土星漫长之弧终于抵达光亮
